final_decision.rationale: compression_jpeg:2: block_boundary=1.2085 (0%FP 信号) 且模拟 1.228 (diff=1.6%<8%), dct_zero_ratio 0.4002 vs 0.4274 (diff=0.027<0.08)。noise_gaussian_RGB:3: verify_signals 三项全 MATCH (sigma/clean_residual/block_boundary)；强度阶梯 1→2→3→4 的 sigma diff 单调 75%→50%→MATCH→38%，sev3 唯一 MATCH；残差 std 23.3 vs 22.2、gm_ratio 1.124 vs 1.114、variance_ratio 0.893 vs 0.895、ch_stds 近等 (排除 YCrCb)、cross_channel_corr 0.806 vs 0.807 全部吻合。blur 排除: spectral_slope_ratio=0.984<1.08, anisotropy=0；在最终管线加入 blur_gaussian:1 后 sigma diff 87%、block_boundary diff 18% → 明确变差。global 排除: 加入 contrast_weaken_stretch:2 导致 mean_shift diff=0.0429、variance_ratio diff=546% → 无温和 x_distortion global 可拟合。遗留差异: target mean_shift=-4.1/255, chroma_ratio 0.911 vs 0.937, clipped_fraction 0.0636 vs 0.0444 — 幅度远低于任何 sev1 global 函数 (brightness shift sev1=-25.5, saturate weaken sev1=0.7)，判定为 JPEG 编码器/裁剪偏差而非独立退化步。噪声 seed 失配 → noise 步骤永不 LIKELY，整体 UNCERTAIN。
